name: scout-client
description: Scout Desktop observes your League of Legends games for Scout.

nsis.preinstallSection:
Section "RemoveScoutClient"
  ReadRegStr $R8 SHCTX "Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\Scout Client" "UninstallString"
  ReadRegStr $R9 SHCTX "Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\Scout Client" "InstallLocation"
  ${If} $R8 != ""
  ${AndIf} $R9 != ""
    ; Both values are stored quoted.
    StrCpy $R8 $R8 -1 1
    StrCpy $R9 $R9 -1 1
    ${If} ${FileExists} "$R8"
      ; _?= keeps the uninstaller in place so ExecWait waits for it. App data
      ; survives: the silent uninstaller never ticks the delete-data box.
      ExecWait '"$R8" /S _?=$R9' $0
      Delete "$R8"
      RMDir "$R9"
    ${EndIf}
  ${EndIf}
SectionEnd
